name: Peninsula Ashok Towers
address: Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Marg, Parel, Mumbai 400012
amenities: Full-size cricket-cum-football ground at the centre of the complex
description: Peninsula Land's first luxury residential complex: about 1.1 million sq ft across four towers on roughly 18 acres in Parel. Three towers are about 30 storeys and Tower D is about 50 storeys (193 m), arranged around a central sports ground. Work began in 2004, and Peninsula handed over three of the four towers in FY2009-10, with the complex completed in 2010. It won the Economic Times Acetech 2010 award for premium housing amenities. Resale units today range from 2 BHK to 5 BHK duplexes, with larger flats listed above Rs 13 crore.
notes: Developer facts are from Peninsula Land annual reports (FY2009-10 and FY2010-11 on BSE) and a Dec 2012 investor presentation (1,077,000 sq ft delivered). The FY2009-10 report describes 'three 30 storey towers and one 50 storey tower'; a later annual report (seen only in a search snippet, not opened) says three 31-storey towers. Wikipedia's list gives Ashok Towers D as 193 m / 49 floors, completed 2010. Mumbai Property Exchange lists possession Dec 2009, used as possession_promised; possession_actual is year-only (2010). No OC date was found. It is a pre-RERA completed building, so there is no MahaRERA ID; Square Yards prints A51800000454, which is Square Yards' own agent registration. Units conflict: 550 (Square Yards / NoBroker description), 782 (NoBroker panel) and 730 (a second Square Yards page), so total_units is left out. That second Square Yards page ('Ashok Towers', ID 62589) shows small units (441-835 sq ft) in wings A4/B2/B3 and a registered average of only Rs 23,500/sq ft (3 sales). It may cover a different building or wings, so it is not used for price points. Loans: the FY2009-10 and FY2010-11 reports show the unsold area of Ashok Towers mortgaged as security for company borrowings. Ready reckoner (2025-26, Parel zone) is about Rs 28,600/sq ft carpet (Mumbai Property Exchange). No launch price or any 2004-2024 price data was found; Mumbai Property Exchange cites an undated 'historical' rate of Rs 19,950/sq ft, which is not used. Computed gross yield: a 3 BHK of 1,500 sq ft asking Rs 3.3 lakh/month (Mumbai Property Exchange, Mar 2026). At the Square Yards registered average of Rs 64,700/sq ft that is about 4.1%, and at the Rs 50,550 asking average about 5.2%. The rent and sale area bases may differ.

news.title: Peninsula Land Annual Report 2009-10: Ashok Towers delivered
news.summary: The chairperson's letter (10 Jun 2010) says the company completed and handed over three of the four towers at Ashok Towers during FY2009-10. The report describes an 18-acre complex of three 30-storey towers and one 50-storey tower, and says work began in 2004.

news.title: Peninsula Land Annual Report 2010-11: ET Acetech award for Ashok Towers
news.summary: Ashok Towers won 'Excellence in Premium Housing Amenities and Entertainment Facilities' at the Economic Times Acetech 2010 Real Estate Awards. The date is the report's 12 May 2011 sign-off.
